currentSurfaceDisposition.reason: SFN-15 requires createXController style behavior controllers with state/actions/parts/getState/subscribe/destroy and part prop getters.

currentSurfaceDisposition.surface: @uifn/core utilities for ids, focus, positioning, roving focus, portal, presence, errors, state
currentSurfaceDisposition.reason: These utilities align with SFN-15 needs if moved behind stable controller and adapter-kit contracts.
Current React adapter has useful breadth but must become controller-backed and conformance-tested, with hook and headless prop getter APIs.
Current Svelte adapter has useful breadth but must expose actions/snippets and pass the shared conformance harness.
Current Vue adapter is experimental and must become first-class with composables, typed props/emits, SSR/hydration, and full conformance.
SFN-15 does not include a public @uifn/files package; useful file UX concepts belong in @uifn/patterns and @uifn/sf.
Scenario ideas should move into Storybook stories, registry fixtures, and manifest-backed examples.
Current gate is too narrow for SFN-15 production readiness and omits target packages, a11y, visual, SSR, docs, manifest, registry, Tailwind, and redaction checks.

conflictsWithSfn15.details: adapter-kit, solid, angular, tokens, theme, theme-tailwind, recipes, components, patterns, sf, registry, and storybook do not exist yet.
Existing packages lack unified uifn.status, layer, schemaVersion, and sourcePolicy metadata required by SFN-15.
Adapters do not yet share a conformance harness across React, Svelte, Vue, Solid, and Angular.
No public semantic token, runtime theme, Tailwind generation, or recipe packages exist.

Current component coverage is primitive-oriented and does not include all Coss target components such as Calendar, Date Picker, Data Table, Sidebar, Resizable, Form, Input OTP, Breadcrumb, Sheet, Skeleton, Typography, and hooks.
No registry, source install CLI, lockfile, or drift detection exists.
No Storybook package, decorators, compatibility panel, or story-driven release gate exists.
